_comment: What is removed from diagnostics before they leave the machine (clipboard, saved report, GitHub issue). Only these things: token-like secrets (a URL credential before an @ counts as one), the home folder (any spelling of it becomes the home placeholder), the account name as a whole word of at least min_account_name_length characters (so a one- or two-letter name cannot shred the report), the profile folder of any other account under a foreign_home_markers prefix (shared_profile_names stay; a name may hold up to path_name_max_words space-separated words when that makes it end at a separator, a quote or the end of the line), the folder and file names under the configuration directory (they are chosen by the user, for example a hotstring pack: the directory becomes config_placeholder and every name below it config_name_placeholder, except the names the product ships, config_known_names), and e-mail addresses. IP and MAC addresses, serial numbers, Wi-Fi names and host names are never collected, so no rule exists for them. A token is its prefix plus at least min_length characters of its charset, not preceded by a letter, digit or underscore. Charsets: alnum = A-Z a-z 0-9, word = alnum plus _, word_dash = word plus -. A key=value secret keeps its key and separator. Implemented by _shared/lua/diagnostics/redact.lua, windows/infra/redact.ahk and _shared/ui/redact.js (the diagnostics page, which redacts what it previews), all three replaying _shared/tests/corpus/diagnostics/redaction_vectors.json.
